acceptance/test_allocate_freight.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.allocate_freight import allocate_freight


def test_proportional():
    assert allocate_freight(1000, [3000, 1000]) == [750, 250]
    assert allocate_freight(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
    assert allocate_freight(0, [0, 0]) == [0, 0]


def test_remainder_ties():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [0, 2]
    assert allocate_freight(5, [1, 3, 6]) == [0, 2, 3]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(-5, [10])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(10, [0, 0])


def test_regression_issue_520():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [1, 1]

acceptance/test_fifo_cogs.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.fifo_cogs import fifo_cogs


def test_consumes_oldest_first():
    assert fifo_cogs([(3, 5, 120), (1, 10, 100)], 12) == (1240, [(3, 3, 120)])
    assert fifo_cogs([(5, 4, 300), (2, 4, 200)], 6) == (1400, [(5, 2, 300)])
    assert fifo_cogs([(2, 1, 50), (2, 1, 70)], 1) == (50, [(2, 1, 70)])


def test_shipping_ahead_of_receipt():
    assert fifo_cogs([(4, 2, 150), (1, 3, 100)], 8) == (1050, [])
    assert fifo_cogs([(6, 1, 90), (6, 1, 95)], 3) == (280, [])


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        fifo_cogs([(1, 1, 100)], -1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        fifo_cogs([], 1)


def test_regression_issue_604():
    assert fifo_cogs([(4, 2, 150), (1, 3, 100)], 8) == (600, [])

acceptance/test_pick_route_order.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.pick_route_order import pick_route_order


def test_single_aisle():
    picks = [("S2", "A-01-05-1", 1), ("S1", "A-01-02-1", 3), ("S3", "A-01-02-0", 2)]
    assert pick_route_order(picks) == [("S3", "A-01-02-0", 2), ("S1", "A-01-02-1", 3), ("S2", "A-01-05-1", 1)]


def test_route_through_aisles():
    picks = [
        ("P1", "A-02-03-1", 1),
        ("P2", "A-01-09-1", 1),
        ("P3", "A-02-11-2", 1),
        ("P4", "B-01-01-1", 1),
        ("P5", "a-01-04-1", 1),
    ]
    assert [p[0] for p in pick_route_order(picks)] == ["P5", "P2", "P3", "P1", "P4"]
    assert pick_route_order([("X", "C-04-01-1", 2), ("Y", "C-04-20-1", 1)]) == [("Y", "C-04-20-1", 1), ("X", "C-04-01-1", 2)]


def test_same_bin_and_errors():
    picks = [("K2", "A-03-03-1", 1), ("K1", "A-03-03-1", 5)]
    assert pick_route_order(picks) == picks
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        pick_route_order([("Z", "A-3-03-1", 1)])


def test_regression_issue_642():
    assert pick_route_order([("X", "C-04-01-1", 2), ("Y", "C-04-20-1", 1)]) == [("X", "C-04-01-1", 2), ("Y", "C-04-20-1", 1)]

import pytest

from stockflow.round_to_pack import round_to_pack


def test_exact_and_minimum():
    assert round_to_pack(24, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(0, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(5, 10, min_packs=3) == 30


def test_rounding():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(18, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(29, 12) == 24


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_to_pack(-1, 12)


def test_regression_issue_142():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 24

acceptance/test_select_lots_fefo.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.select_lots_fefo import select_lots_fefo


def test_fefo_order():
    lots = [("L2", 30, 5), ("L1", 20, 4), ("L3", 25, 10)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=10) == [("L1", 4), ("L3", 2)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 0, today=10) == []


def test_ties_and_shelf_life():
    lots = [("B7", 40, 3), ("A9", 40, 3), ("C1", 15, 8)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10) == [("C1", 4)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10, min_shelf_days=10) == [("A9", 3), ("B7", 1)]


def test_expiry_day_boundary():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X2", 3)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=12)


def test_regression_issue_451():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X1", 3)]
